State Street           Jan 2023-Sep2025 
Emerging Lead

accuracy, consistency, and compliance of critical data assets across the enterprise domain

alignment, community collaboration, and metadata governance.

Data Elements (CDEs) using SQL queries to identify data anomalies and ensure data integrity.

glossary terms, domain ownership, community participation, and asset relatio nships.

architecture with product standards, enterprise data governance policies, domain 
definitions, and community best practices.

tickets, and coordinated with stakeholders to remediate identified issues across domains and 
communities. 
• Onboarded new Critical Data Elements (CDEs) into the application architecture and 
established lineage relationships using Collibra asset functions, including asset creation, 
classification, domain assignment, community mapping, and relationship management.  
• Configured and managed Collibra workflows, customized data capture templates, and 
leveraged JIRA while following Agile methodologies, including Sprint Planning, Product 
Backlog Grooming, and Sprint Backlog Management.  
• Analyzed business requirements and translated them into high -level and low-level use cases, 
activity diagrams, and functional specifications to support data governance, metadata 
management, domain modeling, and community engagement initiatives.  
• Utilized SQL for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities to support 
data quality assessments and lineage verification.  
• Worked closely with Data Stewards, Application Owners, and cross -functional teams to 
enhance metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, domain governance, and 
community collaboration capabilities using Collibra.
